claim_scope: Complete enumeration of two distinct deterministic bfloat16 evaluation orders of the 2022 remainder-added linear map at the published parameter values k=10, a=100, N=1, on all 16385 nonnegative representable states in [0,2].
integrity: Every finite assertion is backed by a reproducible exact-integer graph enumeration with a second rational edge computation and a second independent cycle decomposition; no real-dynamics conclusion is inferred from finite rounding.
limitations: No conclusion for other arithmetic orders, negative states, other precisions, physical devices, or cryptographic security; representable-state basin counts are not Lebesgue probabilities. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Exact bfloat16 cycle spectra under two arithmetic orders of a remainder-added linear map
